items.title: S&P 500 staples earnings: beats are common, but stock reactions diverge
items.summary: Investing.com -- Five of six S&P 500 retail and wholesale staples companies beat third-quarter EPS estimates. That is about 83%, close to the broad market’s 84% beat rate, with 91% of the S&P 500 reported. Stock prices show beats alone are not enough. Quotes are as of 11:05 AM EST on Nov 18 and may lag live prices slightly.

items.title: Sysco (SYY) Affirms Dividend, Is It Still Below Fair Value?
items.summary: Sysco (SYY) just gave investors two things to think about. The board affirmed a quarterly dividend of US$0.55 per share as its veteran Chief Human Resources Officer prepares to shift into an advisory role. Recent trading tells a mixed story. Sysco’s share price is at US$77.99 with a year to date share price return of 7.39%, while the 1 month move is down 5.14%, and the 1 year total shareholder return sits at 5.73%. This points to steady but cooling momentum as investors weigh dividend income...

items.title: WisdomTree U.S. Dividend Growth (DGRW) Adds Broadcom and KLA on Nov. 16
